brief:
# Artemis approved facts — final AI decision with statute cross-check (owner-delegated)

The owner delegated the fact review to the AI ("웬만하면 너가 검토 해", 2026-10-28). Your decisions become "AI-confirmed (owner-delegated)" facts, kept apart from human-approved ones. The post-check will use them only to send answers to review, never to withhold. Be conservative: a wrong fact can flag a correct answer. This is not a legal verification; a fact says "this 2026-10-19 manual page says this".

## Input (read-only)
`packets/chunkN.json` here: `roles`, `pages` (page id → title, text, domain), and `candidates`. Each candidate carries the rule guess (`subject`, `role`, `value`, `source` with an exact `quote`) and `ai_first_pass` (an earlier AI opinion: approve or hold, with subject/role/value and a reason). The earlier opinion is input, not truth. Write only your output file.

## Decide for every candidate
`final`: one of
- `confirm` — a rule-level fact whose subject (status code, and sub-code if the rule is sub-code specific), procedure, role and value you can state from the page. Only if you are confident.
- `reject` — not a fact (example, reference point, boundary inside another rule, duplicate within this packet, OCR fragment, year), or the value is not in the quote.
- `owner` — a real fact you cannot settle from the page (unknown status code, ambiguous flattened table, statute differs, rule seems outdated such as "2025년 기준" in the 2026 manual). Keep this rare and say exactly what to decide.

For `confirm` and `owner` give `subject` (status_code, sub_code or null, procedure "visa"/"stay" matching the page domain, qualifiers: applicant, household_size, per, nationality, row_label, column_label), `role` (from `roles`), `value` (kind, amount, unit, comparator).

**Compound periods** ("4년 10개월", "1년 10개월"): if the rules split one into two candidates, confirm ONE of them with the value in months (e.g. kind period, amount 58, unit month) and reject the other as a duplicate. The checker accepts a month total when the quote holds "N년 M개월".

**Missing status codes**: read the page title and surrounding text; many stay-manual pages belong to one status chapter even when the code is not printed on that page. Confirm only if the chapter is clear from the page itself (e.g. the title or a heading on the page); otherwise `owner`.

## Statute cross-check (law MCP)
Load with ToolSearch `select:mcp__693f13de-8f71-44f6-aba3-570dfc92e726__search_law,mcp__693f13de-8f71-44f6-aba3-570dfc92e726__get_law_text,mcp__693f13de-8f71-44f6-aba3-570dfc92e726__get_annexes`.
Known: 출입국관리법 MST 290729; 시행령 MST 290501; 시행규칙 MST 291289 (current, 2026-10-23; the 2026-10-19 version is MST 289833); 외국인근로자의 고용 등에 관한 법률 MST 276857. Useful provisions: 시행규칙 제72조 (fees), 별표 1 (stay-period caps), 제44조의2 (re-entry exemption), 제9조 (consular delegation), 별표 5/5의2 (attachments); 법 제35조, 제36조 (change reports, 15일 / 14일); 외국인고용법 제18조, 제18조의2, 제25조. Fetch each provision once and reuse it for every candidate it covers.
`legal_check.result`: `consistent` | `differs` | `not_in_statute` (manual operating standard) | `not_checked`. Quote the statute text you relied on exactly (≤ 200 chars), with law, provision, MST. If it `differs`, the decision is `owner` (never change the value to the statute). Do not spend calls on items no statute governs (income tables, document lists, 공관 재량 periods): mark `not_in_statute`.

## Output
`out/chunkN.json`, a JSON array in packet order:
```json
{"candidate_id": "fc-…", "final": "confirm|reject|owner", "subject": {...} or null, "role": "...", "value": {...} or null,
 "legal_check": {"result": "...", "law": "", "provision": "", "mst": "", "excerpt": ""},
 "reason": "Korean, 1–2 sentences", "owner_question": "only for owner: what to decide"}
```
Self-check with `python3 -I` before writing: one object per candidate in order; finals in the set; roles in `roles`; for confirm/owner the amount appears in the quote (digits without commas; 억/만/천 units; for a month total, "N년 M개월" in the quote with N*12+M = amount); procedure matches the page domain. Report in five lines: counts of confirm / reject / owner, counts of legal results, the self-check result, and every `differs` with one line.
